chain.title: A searchable storage block
chain.desc: Place Modular Storage and open its interface. It needs a Storage Module to hold items; prepare the module before transferring a valuable collection.

chain.title: Add the first storage module
chain.desc: Insert a Tier 1 Storage Module into Modular Storage. Items are stored in the module, so handle a filled module as carefully as the chest contents it replaces.

chain.title: Expand the module's capacity
chain.desc: Use the installed upgrade recipe for the next module tier. Verify that the recipe preserves contents, and move valuable items to a safe inventory first if you are unsure about pack changes.

chain.title: Room for a growing collection
chain.desc: Upgrade the storage module when its stack capacity becomes the bottleneck. Extra capacity is useful without requiring a new network or remote-access system.

chain.title: The largest normal module tier
chain.desc: Finish the normal storage-module ladder and reinstall the module. This guide excludes the legacy internal remote module and creative variants.

chain.title: Search the chests you already own
chain.desc: Power a Storage Scanner, scan the intended area, and choose which inventories should be available. Test retrieval and insertion before reorganizing the whole storeroom.

chain.title: Link a remote storage control
chain.desc: Bind a Storage Control Module to the intended scanner. Use it in the supported screen or tablet interface, keeping the scanner powered and available.

chain.title: Put carried supplies away deliberately
chain.desc: Bind and configure a Dump Module for the scanner's storage. Set filters and test with expendable items before using it on a full personal inventory.

chain.title: Test storage from your tablet
chain.desc: Install the linked Storage Control Module in a charged Tablet. Open the remote scanner and retrieve a test stack, then confirm this milestone when the connection works.

coverage.scope: Authored branched progression; item and component acquisition objectives, not automatic proof that a factory works.
milestones: Modular storage and four normal capacity tiers
limits: storage_module6 is a legacy/internal module without a normal recipe; tablet_scanner is a configured tablet state, so neither is an acquisition objective.
The short guide reflects the actual small module, not an invented quota.
Pack scripts, recipe changes, and other Minecraft versions require the installed-pack scan; this guide is not a complete mod manual.
coverage.verification: Local JAR item models and English registry names; selected recipes and bundled manuals checked. Not a new in-game playthrough.

notes: Re-reviewed 2026-10-07 against local Minecraft 1.20.1 JAR item assets and selected recipes/manuals, with official project sources listed separately. Every authored row now has explicit prerequisites; empty lists identify intentional branch roots. The coverage section states the verified versions and remaining limits. This replaces older list-order and item-count claims.
